blocks.text: * When creating a Claude Managed Agents session, you can now seed it with initial events. Pass `initial_events` on `POST /v1/sessions` with up to 50 `user.message` and `user.define_outcome` events. A non-empty list starts the agent loop in the same call, so you don’t need a separate send-events request to start work.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 22, 2026
blocks.text: * The `version` field is now optional when updating a Claude Managed Agents agent. Supply it for optimistic concurrency (a mismatch returns a 409 error), or omit it to apply the update unconditionally. See Update semantics.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 22, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Managed Agents session thread event streams now support event deltas. `GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/threads/{thread_id}/stream` accepts the same `event_deltas[]` query parameter as the session-level stream, so you can preview a subagent’s text as the model generates it. A connection previews only the thread it’s reading. See Preview session thread events.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 17, 2026
blocks.text: * The legacy **Workbench** (platform.claude.com/workbench) in the Claude Console is being sunset with access ending on August 17, 2026. Saved prompts, variables, and evals are not supported in the updated Workbench in the Console. You can export any data you want to keep from the banner and under your **Organizational Settings**. For more, see How do I use the Workbench? in the Claude Help Center.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 17, 2026
blocks.text: * The experimental prompt tools APIs for generating, improving, and templatizing prompts (`/v1/experimental/generate_prompt`, `/v1/experimental/improve_prompt`, and `/v1/experimental/templatize_prompt`) are being retired along with the Workbench on August 17, 2026. After removal, requests to these endpoints will return an error.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 15, 2026
blocks.text: * Mid-conversation system messages are available on Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, and Claude Opus 4.8, on the Claude API, Claude in Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud. No beta header is required. This corrects earlier availability notes.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 14, 2026
blocks.text: * You can now manage the people in your **Claude Enterprise** (claude.ai) organization with the Admin API, in beta for all Claude Enterprise organizations: list members and look them up by email address, change a member’s role, remove members, send and withdraw invites, manage groups and their membership, and read custom roles. Group and custom-role requests require the `anthropic-beta: ce-user-management-2026-07-13` beta header; member and invite requests take no beta header. An Admin API key with the `read:org_audit` scope can also call every user-management `GET` endpoint. See User management.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 10, 2026
blocks.text: * Dreams (research preview) now supports Claude Fable 5 and Claude Sonnet 5. See Supported models.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 10, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve expanded the Access Transparency documentation of `cmek_preserve` events with a filter example, an example event payload, and two preservation reason codes (`policy_violation_investigation`, `csae_report`). The documentation now also clarifies that a preservation event is written whether the preservation was initiated by a human reviewer or an automated safety pipeline. See CMEK content preservation.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 8, 2026
blocks.text: * You can now set an expiration when you create an API key or an Admin API key in the Claude Console. Choose a preset, a custom duration, or **Never**. For keys with a lifetime of at least 7 days, Anthropic emails the creator before expiration. Existing keys are unaffected. The Admin API reports each key’s expiration in the `expires_at` field. See Key expiration in Authentication.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 2, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve added the `agent-memory-2026-07-22` beta header, which changes how listing memories (`GET /v1/memory_stores/{memory_store_id}/memories`) behaves: results are returned in a stable, server-defined order and the `order_by` and `order` parameters are ignored; `depth` accepts only `0`, `1`, or being omitted (other values return a `400` error); and `path_prefix` must end with `/` and matches whole path segments instead of a substring. Page cursors issued without the header aren’t valid with it, so restart from the first page when you adopt it. On memory store endpoints, `agent-memory-2026-07-22` replaces `managed-agents-2026-04-01`; sending both returns a `400` error. On July 22, 2026, the `managed-agents-2026-04-01` header adopts the same list behavior. See Beta headers.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 2, 2026
blocks.text: * The Python (0.116.0), TypeScript (0.110.0), Go (1.56.0), Java (2.48.0), Ruby (1.55.0), PHP (0.36.0), C# (12.35.0), and CLI (1.16.0) SDKs now send `agent-memory-2026-07-22` on all memory store calls instead of `managed-agents-2026-04-01`. If your code passes `betas` explicitly on memory store calls, replace `managed-agents-2026-04-01` with `agent-memory-2026-07-22` there rather than adding a second value.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 1, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve restored access to Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5. See our statement for more information.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 30, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched **Claude Sonnet 5** (`claude-sonnet-5`), the next generation of our Sonnet model family, at introductory pricing of $2 / $10 USD per MTok (made the standard price on August 10, 2026). Claude Sonnet 5 supports a 1M token context window, 128k max output tokens, and the same set of tools and platform features as Claude Sonnet 4.6, except Priority Tier, which is not available on Claude Sonnet 5. Three behavior changes apply when migrating: adaptive thinking is now on by default; manual extended thinking (`thinking: {type: "enabled", budget_tokens: N}`) is removed and returns a 400 error (it was deprecated on Sonnet 4.6); and setting sampling parameters (`temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`) to non-default values returns a 400 error. Claude Sonnet 5 also uses a new tokenizer that produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text. The exact increase depends on the content and workload shape. See What’s new in Claude Sonnet 5 for details and migration guidance. For behavioral differences and model-specific prompting patterns, see Prompting Claude Sonnet 5.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 30, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Managed Agents session event streams now support event deltas. Opt in with the `event_deltas[]` query parameter on `GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events/stream`. The `event_start` and `event_delta` events preview an agent message’s text as it’s generated, before the complete `agent.message` event arrives.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 30, 2026
blocks.text: * Listing sessions for Claude Managed Agents now supports backward pagination. `GET /v1/sessions` returns a `prev_page` cursor alongside `next_page`; pass it as the `page` parameter to return to the previous page. See Pagination.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 30, 2026
blocks.text: * When creating a Claude Managed Agents session, you can now override the agent’s configuration for that session. Pass `agent` with `type: "agent_with_overrides"` to replace the model, system prompt, tools, MCP servers, or skills for a single session. The agent itself is unchanged.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 30, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Managed Agents vaults now support an `injection_location` setting on environment variable credentials (the Environment variable tab). It controls whether the credential’s value is substituted, at egress, into the agent’s outbound request headers, the request body, or both.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 30, 2026
blocks.text: * Webhooks for Claude Managed Agents now cover the agent, deployment, and deployment run lifecycle. You can react to a newly published agent version, a paused deployment, or a failed scheduled run without polling. See the Agent events, Deployment events, and Deployment run events tabs in Supported event types.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 29, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve removed fast mode for Claude Opus 4.6. Requests to `claude-opus-4-6` with `speed: "fast"` no longer run at fast speed or premium pricing: they run at standard speed, are billed at standard rates, and do not return an error. The response’s `usage.speed` field reports the speed used. To continue using fast mode, migrate to Claude Opus 4.8. Read more in Fast mode model availability.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 26, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve raised rate limits across the Claude API. Claude Sonnet and Claude Haiku rate limits now match Claude Opus at every usage tier, and usage tiers have been consolidated into three: Start, Build, and Scale. Most organizations move to a higher tier, no organization receives lower limits than before, and no action is required. You can view your tier and current limits in the Claude Console.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 25, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve deprecated fast mode for Claude Opus 4.7, with removal on July 24, 2026. After removal, requests to `claude-opus-4-7` with `speed: "fast"` will return an error. Migrate to fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8. Read more in Fast mode model availability.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 22, 2026
blocks.text: * **MCP tunnels** (research preview): the management API moved from `/v1/organizations/tunnels` on the Admin API to `/v1/tunnels` on the Claude API. The new surface uses the `anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22` header and the `workspace:manage_tunnels` WIF scope. The previous surface remains available during a migration window. See the Tunnels API reference.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 18, 2026
blocks.text: * The Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP, and C# SDKs now include support for `code_execution_20260120`, the code execution tool version that adds REPL state persistence and is the minimum version for programmatic tool calling. To adopt it, set the tool’s `type` to `code_execution_20260120`; no beta header is required. It’s available on Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 4.5 and newer, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 and newer; see the code execution tool’s API support section.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 15, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the Claude Sonnet 4 model (`claude-sonnet-4-20250514`) and the Claude Opus 4 model (`claude-opus-4-20250514`). All requests to these models on the Claude API will now return an error. We recommend upgrading to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 respectively. Researchers can request ongoing access through the External Researcher Access Program.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 11, 2026
blocks.text: * The code execution tool now supports `code_execution_20260521`, which discloses the 90-second per-cell execution time limit in the tool description so Claude can budget long-running cells. No beta header is required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 11, 2026
blocks.text: * The web search tool and web fetch tool now support `web_search_20260318` and `web_fetch_20260318`, adding a `response_inclusion` parameter to drop consumed result blocks from the API response for agentic workflows. No beta header is required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 10, 2026
blocks.text: * The `GET /v1/environments/{id}/work` endpoint, which lists pending work for a self-hosted sandbox, is now available on Claude Platform on AWS. See IAM actions for Claude Platform on AWS for the `GetEnvironment` action that authorizes it.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched **Claude Fable 5** (`claude-fable-5`), our most capable model open to all customers, alongside **Claude Mythos 5** (`claude-mythos-5`) for Project Glasswing participants. Both models support a 1M token context window by default, 128k max output tokens, and always-on adaptive thinking. See Claude Fable 5 for specifications, pricing, and availability.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 use the tokenizer introduced with Claude Opus 4.7. Compared to models before Claude Opus 4.7, the same text produces roughly 30% more tokens. The exact increase depends on the content and workload shape. Use the token counting API with `model: "claude-fable-5"` to measure your prompts under the new tokenizer.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Fable 5 runs safety classifiers on requests and during response generation. When a classifier declines a request, the Messages API returns `stop_reason: "refusal"`. You are not billed for a request refused before any output is generated. An opt-in `fallbacks` parameter (in beta on the Claude API and Claude Platform on AWS; not supported on the Message Batches API) re-runs refused requests on another model, billed at the fallback model’s rates. See Handling stop reasons.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * The `stop_details.category` field on refusal responses now includes `"reasoning_extraction"` on Claude Fable 5, returned when a request is blocked under Anthropic’s Terms of Service restrictions on reverse engineering or duplicating model outputs. The existing `"cyber"` and `"bio"` categories are unchanged. No beta header is required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * On Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, adaptive thinking is the only thinking mode: `thinking: {"type": "disabled"}` is not supported, and manual extended thinking budgets and assistant prefill are not supported (both return a 400 error).

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * On Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, `thinking.display` defaults to `"omitted"`, the same as Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Mythos Preview; set `display: "summarized"` to receive readable thinking summaries. The raw chain of thought is never returned; pass thinking blocks back unchanged in multi-turn conversations on the same model. See Thinking output on Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Fable 5 requires 30-day data retention and is not available under zero data retention. See Model-specific data retention requirements.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Managed Agents now supports scheduled deployments, letting you run sessions on a cron schedule without managing your own scheduler.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Managed Agents vaults now support environment variable credentials, so you can securely inject secrets into the agent’s sandbox for CLIs, SDKs, and other services that authenticate through environment variables.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * The Compliance API Activity Feed (`GET /v1/compliance/activities`) is now available on Claude Platform on AWS. See Compliance IAM actions for Claude Platform on AWS for the `ListComplianceActivities` action that authorizes it.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * The `session.thread_*` webhook events now include a `session_thread_id` field identifying the multiagent thread that triggered the event.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 9, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve released a Swift package in beta that adds Claude as a server-side `LanguageModel` in Apple’s Foundation Models framework. Call Claude through the same `LanguageModelSession` API as Apple’s on-device model on iOS 27, macOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27 (beta).

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 5, 2026
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude Opus 4.1 model (`claude-opus-4-1-20250805`), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for August 5, 2026. We recommend migrating to Claude Opus 4.8. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 2, 2026
blocks.text: * The advisor tool now supports a `max_tokens` parameter to cap the advisor model’s output for each call, reducing latency and output token cost for workloads that don’t need full-length advisor responses. Set `tools[].max_tokens` on the advisor tool definition; see Capping advisor output.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 2, 2026
blocks.text: * On the Claude API, you are no longer billed for a request when it returns `stop_reason: "refusal"` without Claude having generated any output. See Streaming refusals for detecting and handling refusals.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 29, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Managed Agents webhooks, multiagent orchestration, and self-hosted sandboxes are now available on Claude Platform on AWS. See IAM actions for Claude Platform on AWS for the new IAM actions and the `AnthropicSelfHostedEnvironmentAccess` managed policy.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched **Claude Opus 4.8** (), our most capable model. Claude Opus 4.8 supports a 1M token context window by default on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, 128k max output tokens, and the same set of tools and platform features as Claude Opus 4.7. See the migration guide for baseline settings, features, and migration guidance.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched mid-conversation system messages. On Claude Opus 4.8, you can send `role: "system"` messages after a user turn (subject to placement rules) in the `messages` array, preserving prompt cache hits when instructions change during a long-running session. No beta header is required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * The `stop_details` field on refusal responses is now publicly documented; it returns a `category` (`cyber`, `bio`, or `null`) and a human-readable `explanation`, so your application can route different classes of refusal to the right next step. No beta header is required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * On Claude Opus 4.8, the effort parameter defaults to `high` across all surfaces, including Claude Code and the Messages API.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * On Claude Opus 4.8, the minimum cacheable prompt length for prompt caching is 1,024 tokens, lower than on Claude Opus 4.7.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * With adaptive thinking enabled, Claude Opus 4.8 triggers reasoning only when a turn needs it, reducing wasted thinking tokens compared to Claude Opus 4.7 at the same effort level.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Opus 4.8 supports high-resolution image input (up to 2576 pixels on the long edge), same as Claude Opus 4.7.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * Task budgets now support Claude Opus 4.8.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * The advisor tool now supports Claude Opus 4.8.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * Computer use now supports Claude Opus 4.8.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * Fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 is available as a research preview on the Claude API only.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * Setting the sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` to a non-default value returns a 400 error on Claude Opus 4.8, same as on Claude Opus 4.7. See the migration guide for details.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * In Claude Code, we’ve expanded Auto mode to more users for long-running tasks. See the Claude Code documentation.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * In Claude Code, Max plan users now default to fast mode on Claude Opus 4.8. See the Claude Code documentation.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * In Claude Code, Workflows are available as a research preview, letting you define and run multistep agentic plans. See the Claude Code documentation.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve deprecated fast mode for Claude Opus 4.6, with removal approximately 30 days after launch. Migrate to fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 or Claude Opus 4.7. Read more in Fast mode model availability.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 28, 2026
blocks.text: * For updates to claude.ai, Cowork, Claude for Microsoft 365, and other Claude apps in this release, see the release notes for Claude Apps.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 27, 2026
blocks.text: * The Messages API response now includes `usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens`, reporting how many of the billed output tokens were extended thinking. When streaming, the breakdown appears only on the final `message_delta` event. No beta header is required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 19, 2026
blocks.text: * MCP tunnels is now available as a research preview, so you can connect to MCP servers in your private network.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 19, 2026
blocks.text: * Self-hosted sandboxes are now available for Claude Managed Agents, as an alternative to running tool execution in Anthropic’s infrastructure. See Self-hosted sandboxes.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 19, 2026
blocks.text: * With Claude Managed Agents, you can now update the agent’s MCP server and tool configurations associated with an active session.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 19, 2026
blocks.text: * With Claude Managed Agents, large outputs from `agent_toolset` and MCP tools exceeding 100K characters (about 25K tokens) are now automatically spilled to a file in the sandbox. The model receives a truncated preview with the file path and can read the full content from there.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 18, 2026
blocks.text: * The web search tool now returns richer SEC filing data, making it easier to ground financial research agents, earnings analysis, and due-diligence workflows in primary sources with citations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 13, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched cache diagnostics in beta. Pass `diagnostics.previous_message_id` on a Messages request and the API reports a `cache_miss_reason` explaining where the prompt cache prefix diverged from the previous turn. Include the `cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07` beta header in your requests.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 12, 2026
blocks.text: * Fast mode (research preview) now supports Claude Opus 4.7. Set `speed: "fast"` with `model: "claude-opus-4-7"` and the `fast-mode-2026-02-01` beta header for significantly faster output token generation at premium pricing. Pricing, rate limits, and access are the same as for Opus 4.6 fast mode; interested customers should join the waitlist.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 11, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched **Claude Platform on AWS**, bringing the Claude API to Anthropic-managed infrastructure accessible through AWS, with AWS billing and IAM authentication. Access the full Messages API, Files API, Message Batches API, Claude Managed Agents, Agent Skills, code execution, and tool use through native AWS endpoints. Learn more in Claude Platform on AWS.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 6, 2026
blocks.text: * Multiagent orchestration and Outcomes are now in beta under the standard `managed-agents-2026-04-01` beta header.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 6, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Managed Agents vault credential background refresh is now supported for `mcp_oauth` credentials. See Authenticate with vaults.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 6, 2026
blocks.text: * Webhooks for Claude Managed Agents are now supported. Webhook event types include session and vault lifecycle events. See Subscribe to webhooks.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 6, 2026
blocks.text: * Additional filtering and sorting options are now supported for Claude Managed Agents. Sessions can be filtered by status, and events can be filtered by type. Events can now be filtered by creation time.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 6, 2026
blocks.text: * Dreams for Claude Managed Agents are now available as a research preview. A dream reads an existing memory store alongside past session transcripts and produces a reorganized output memory store with duplicates merged, stale entries replaced, and new insights surfaced. Dream endpoints are gated by the `dreaming-2026-04-21` beta header. Request access to try it.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 4, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Workload Identity Federation. Authenticate workloads to the Claude API with short-lived OIDC tokens from your own identity provider (AWS IAM, Google Cloud, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, SPIFFE, and more) instead of long-lived static API keys. Configure issuers and federation rules in the Claude Console, and the SDK handles token exchange and refresh automatically. See Authentication.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 30, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the 1M token context window beta (`context-1m-2025-08-07`) for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4. The beta header now has no effect on these models, and requests exceeding the standard 200k-token context window return an error. To use the 1M context window, migrate to Claude Sonnet 4.6 or Claude Opus 4.6, where it’s included at standard pricing with no beta header required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 29, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve released the Claude API skill, an open-source Agent Skill that gives Claude up-to-date reference material for building on the Messages API and Claude Managed Agents across 8 languages. The skill is bundled with Claude Code and available in the Anthropic skills repository.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 24, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve released the Rate Limits API, allowing administrators to programmatically query the rate limits configured for their organization and workspaces.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 23, 2026
blocks.text: * Memory for Claude Managed Agents is now in beta under the standard `managed-agents-2026-04-01` header. See Using agent memory for the full integration guide.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 20, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the Claude Haiku 3 model (`claude-3-haiku-20240307`). All requests to this model will now return an error. We recommend upgrading to Claude Haiku 4.5.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 16, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Opus 4.7, our most capable model for complex reasoning and agentic coding, at the same $5 / $25 USD per MTok pricing as Opus 4.6. See What’s new in Claude Opus 4.7 for capability improvements, new features, and the updated tokenizer. Opus 4.7 includes API breaking changes versus Opus 4.6; see the migration guide before upgrading.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 16, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude in Amazon Bedrock is now open to all Amazon Bedrock customers. Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Haiku 4.5 are available self-serve from the Bedrock console through the Messages API endpoint at `/anthropic/v1/messages`, in 27 AWS regions with global and regional endpoints.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 16, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched task budgets in beta on Claude Opus 4.7. Give Claude an advisory token budget for a full agentic loop (thinking, tool calls, tool results, and output) and the model sees a running countdown, using it to prioritize work and finish gracefully as the budget is consumed. Include the `task-budgets-2026-03-13` beta header in your requests.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 16, 2026
blocks.text: * Claude Opus 4.7 supports high-resolution image input, raising the maximum image resolution from 1568 to 2576 pixels on the long edge for improved performance on computer use, screenshot understanding, and document analysis. High-resolution support is automatic and requires no beta header; images may use up to approximately 3x more image tokens than on prior models.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 16, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve added the `xhigh` effort level on Claude Opus 4.7. `xhigh` sits between `high` and `max` and is tuned for long-running agentic and coding tasks (over 30 minutes) with token budgets in the millions. No beta header is required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 14, 2026
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 4 model (`claude-sonnet-4-20250514`) and the Claude Opus 4 model (`claude-opus-4-20250514`), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for June 15, 2026. We recommend migrating to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.8 respectively. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 9, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the advisor tool in beta. Pair a faster executor model with a higher-intelligence advisor model that provides strategic guidance mid-generation, so long-horizon agentic workloads get close to advisor-solo quality while the bulk of token generation happens at executor-model rates. Include the beta header `advisor-tool-2026-03-01` in your requests.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 8, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched **Claude Managed Agents** in beta, a fully managed agent harness for running Claude as an autonomous agent with secure sandboxing, built-in tools, and server-sent event streaming. Create agents, configure containers, and run sessions through the API. All endpoints require the `managed-agents-2026-04-01` beta header. Learn more in Claude Managed Agents overview.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 8, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the **`ant` CLI**, a command-line client for the Claude API that enables faster interaction with the Claude API, native integration with Claude Code, and versioning of API resources in YAML files. Learn more in the CLI quickstart.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 7, 2026
blocks.text: * We announced Claude Mythos Preview is available as a gated research preview for defensive cybersecurity work as part of Project Glasswing. Access is invitation-only.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 7, 2026
blocks.text: * The Messages API is now available on Amazon Bedrock as a research preview. The new Claude in Amazon Bedrock endpoint at `/anthropic/v1/messages` uses the same request shape as the first-party Claude API and runs on AWS-managed infrastructure with zero operator access. Available in `us-east-1`; contact your Anthropic account executive to request access. Learn more in Claude in Amazon Bedrock.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 30, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve raised the `max_tokens` cap to 300k on the Message Batches API for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6. Include the `output-300k-2026-03-24` beta header to generate longer single-turn outputs for long-form content, structured data, and large code generation tasks.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 30, 2026
blocks.text: * We’re retiring the 1M token context window beta for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4 on **April 30, 2026**. After that date, the `context-1m-2025-08-07` beta header will have no effect on these models, and requests that exceed the standard 200k-token context window will return an error. To continue using 1M context windows, migrate to Claude Sonnet 4.6 or Claude Opus 4.6, which support the full 1M token context window at standard pricing with no beta header required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 18, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve added model capability fields to the Models API. `GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` now return `max_input_tokens`, `max_tokens`, and a `capabilities` object. Query the API to discover what each model supports.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 16, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the `display` field for extended thinking, letting you omit thinking content from responses for faster streaming. Set `thinking.display: "omitted"` to receive thinking blocks with an empty `thinking` field and the `signature` preserved for multi-turn continuity. Billing is unchanged. Learn more in Controlling thinking display.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 13, 2026
blocks.text: * The 1M token context window is out of beta for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, at standard pricing. Requests over 200k tokens work automatically for these models with no beta header required. The 1M token context window remains in beta for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Sonnet 4.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 13, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve removed the dedicated 1M rate limits for all supported models. Your standard account limits now apply across every context length.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 13, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve raised the media limit from 100 to 600 images or PDF pages for each request when using the 1M token context window.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 19, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched **automatic caching** for the Messages API. Add a single `cache_control` field to your request body and the system automatically caches the last cacheable block, moving the cache point forward as conversations grow. No manual breakpoint management required. Works alongside existing block-level cache control for fine-grained optimization. Available on the Claude API and Microsoft Foundry (preview). Learn more in Automatic caching.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 19, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the Claude Sonnet 3.7 model (`claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219`) and the Claude Haiku 3.5 model (`claude-3-5-haiku-20241022`). All requests to Claude Sonnet 3.7 will now return an error. Requests to Claude Haiku 3.5 on the Claude API will now return an error; it remains available on Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud. We recommend upgrading to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Haiku 4.5 respectively. Researchers can request ongoing access through the External Researcher Access Program.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 19, 2026
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude Haiku 3 model (`claude-3-haiku-20240307`), with retirement scheduled for April 20, 2026. We recommend migrating to Claude Haiku 4.5. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 17, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Sonnet 4.6, our latest balanced model combining speed and intelligence for everyday tasks. Sonnet 4.6 delivers improved agentic search performance while consuming fewer tokens. Sonnet 4.6 supports extended thinking and a 1M token context window (beta). See Models & Pricing for details.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 17, 2026
blocks.text: * API code execution is now **free when used with web search or web fetch**. Sandboxed code execution improves model capability and token efficiency. See the pricing details for standalone usage.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 17, 2026
blocks.text: * The web search tool and programmatic tool calling are available with no beta header required. Web search and web fetch now support dynamic filtering, which uses code execution to filter results before they reach the context window for better performance and reduced token cost.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 17, 2026
blocks.text: * The code execution tool, web fetch tool, tool search tool, tool use examples, and memory tool no longer require a beta header.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 7, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched fast mode in research preview for Opus 4.6, providing significantly faster output token generation through the `speed` parameter. Fast mode is up to 2.5x as fast at premium pricing. Interested customers should join the waitlist.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 5, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Opus 4.6, our most intelligent model for complex agentic tasks and long-horizon work. Opus 4.6 recommends adaptive thinking (`thinking: {type: "adaptive"}`); manual thinking (`type: "enabled"` with `budget_tokens`) is deprecated. Opus 4.6 does not support prefilling assistant messages. Learn more in What’s new in Claude 4.6.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 5, 2026
blocks.text: * The effort parameter no longer requires a beta header and now supports Claude Opus 4.6. Effort replaces `budget_tokens` for controlling thinking depth on new models.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 5, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the compaction API in beta, providing server-side context summarization for effectively infinite conversations. Available on Opus 4.6.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 5, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve introduced data residency controls, allowing you to specify where model inference runs with the `inference_geo` parameter. US-only inference is available at 1.1x pricing for models released after February 1, 2026.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 5, 2026
blocks.text: * The 1M token context window is now available in beta for Claude Opus 4.6, in addition to Sonnet 4.5 and Sonnet 4. Long context pricing applies to requests exceeding 200k input tokens.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 5, 2026
blocks.text: * Fine-grained tool streaming no longer requires a beta header on any model or platform.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 29, 2026
blocks.text: * Structured outputs are out of beta on the Claude API for Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. This release includes expanded schema support, improved grammar compilation latency, and a simplified integration path with no beta header required. The `output_format` parameter has moved to `output_config.format`. Existing beta users can continue using the beta header during the transition period. Structured outputs remain in beta on Amazon Bedrock and Microsoft Foundry.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 12, 2026
blocks.text: * `console.anthropic.com` now redirects to `platform.claude.com`. The Claude Console has moved to its new home as part of our Claude brand consolidation. Existing bookmarks and links will continue working through an automatic redirect. For more details, see the September 16, 2025 announcement.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 5, 2026
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the Claude Opus 3 model (`claude-3-opus-20240229`). All requests to this model will now return an error. We recommend upgrading to Claude Opus 4.5, which offers significantly improved intelligence at a third of the cost. Researchers can request ongoing access to Claude Opus 3 on the API through the External Researcher Access Program.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 19, 2025
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude Haiku 3.5 model. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 4, 2025
blocks.text: * Structured outputs now support Claude Haiku 4.5.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 24, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Opus 4.5, our most intelligent model combining maximum capability with practical performance. Ideal for complex specialized tasks, professional software engineering, and advanced agents. Features step-change improvements in vision, coding, and computer use at a more accessible price point than previous Opus models. Learn more in Models overview.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 24, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched programmatic tool calling in beta, allowing Claude to call tools from within code execution to reduce latency and token usage in multi-tool workflows.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 24, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the tool search tool in beta, enabling Claude to dynamically discover and load tools on-demand from large tool catalogs.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 24, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the effort parameter in beta for Claude Opus 4.5, allowing you to control token usage by trading off between response thoroughness and efficiency.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 24, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added client-side compaction to our Python and TypeScript SDKs, automatically managing conversation context through summarization when using `tool_runner`.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 21, 2025
blocks.text: * Search result content blocks are now available on Amazon Bedrock with no beta header required. Learn more in Search results.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 19, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched a **new documentation platform** at platform.claude.com/docs. Our documentation now lives side by side with the Claude Console, providing a unified developer experience. The previous docs site at docs.claude.com will redirect to the new location.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 18, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched **Claude in Microsoft Foundry**, bringing Claude models to Azure customers with Azure billing and OAuth authentication. Access the full Messages API including extended thinking, prompt caching (5-minute and 1-hour), PDF support, Files API, Agent Skills, and tool use. Learn more in Claude in Microsoft Foundry.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 14, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched structured outputs in beta, providing guaranteed schema conformance for Claude’s responses. Use JSON outputs for structured data responses or strict tool use for validated tool inputs. Available for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Opus 4.1. To enable, use the beta header `structured-outputs-2025-11-13`.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 28, 2025
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 3.7 model. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 28, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the Claude Sonnet 3.5 models. All requests to these models will now return an error.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 28, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve expanded context editing with thinking block clearing (`clear_thinking_20251015`), enabling automatic management of thinking blocks. Learn more in Context editing.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 16, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Agent Skills (`skills-2025-10-02` beta), a new way to extend Claude’s capabilities. Skills are organized folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to perform specialized tasks. The initial release includes:

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 16, 2025
blocks.text: + **Anthropic-managed Skills**: Pre-built Skills for working with PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), Word (.docx), and PDF files

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 16, 2025
blocks.text: + **Custom Skills**: Upload your own Skills through the Skills API (`/v1/skills` endpoints) to package domain expertise and organizational workflows

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 16, 2025
blocks.text: + Skills require the code execution tool to be enabled

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 16, 2025
blocks.text: + Learn more in Agent Skills and API reference

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 15, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Haiku 4.5, our fastest and most intelligent Haiku model with near-frontier performance. Ideal for real-time applications, high-volume processing, and cost-sensitive deployments requiring strong reasoning. Learn more in Models overview.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 29, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Sonnet 4.5, our best model for complex agents and coding, with the highest intelligence across most tasks. Learn more in the models overview.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 29, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve introduced global endpoint pricing for Amazon Bedrock and Vertex AI. The Claude API (1P) pricing is unaffected.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 29, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve introduced a new stop reason `model_context_window_exceeded` that allows you to request the maximum possible tokens without calculating input size. Learn more in Handling stop reasons.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 29, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the memory tool in beta, enabling Claude to store and consult information across conversations. Learn more in Memory tool.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 29, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched context editing in beta, providing strategies to automatically manage conversation context. The initial release supports clearing older tool results and calls when approaching token limits. Learn more in Context editing.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 17, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched tool helpers in beta for the Python and TypeScript SDKs, simplifying tool creation and execution with type-safe input validation and a tool runner for automated tool handling in conversations. For details, see the documentation for the Python SDK and the TypeScript SDK.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 16, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve unified our developer offerings under the Claude brand. You should see updated naming and URLs across our platform and documentation, but **our developer interfaces will remain the same**. Here are some notable changes:

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 16, 2025
blocks.text: + Claude Console (console.anthropic.com) → Claude Console (platform.claude.com). The console will be available at both URLs until January 12, 2026. After that date, console.anthropic.com will automatically redirect to platform.claude.com.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 16, 2025
blocks.text: + Anthropic Docs (docs.anthropic.com) → Claude Docs (docs.claude.com)

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 16, 2025
blocks.text: + Anthropic Help Center (support.anthropic.com) → Claude Help Center (support.claude.com)

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 16, 2025
blocks.text: + API endpoints, headers, environment variables, and SDKs remain the same. Your existing integrations will continue working without any changes.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 10, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the web fetch tool in beta, allowing Claude to retrieve full content from specified web pages and PDF documents. Learn more in Web fetch tool.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 10, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the Claude Code Analytics API, enabling organizations to programmatically access daily aggregated usage metrics for Claude Code, including productivity metrics, tool usage statistics, and cost data.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 8, 2025
blocks.text: * We launched a beta version of the C# SDK.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 5, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched rate limit charts in the Console Usage page, allowing you to monitor your API rate limit usage and caching rates over time.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 3, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched support for citable documents in client-side tool results. Learn more in Handle tool calls.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 2, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched v2 of the Code Execution Tool in beta, replacing the original Python-only tool with Bash command execution and direct file manipulation capabilities, including writing code in other languages.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 27, 2025
blocks.text: * We launched a beta version of the PHP SDK.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 26, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve increased rate limits on the 1M token context window for Claude Sonnet 4 on the Claude API.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 26, 2025
blocks.text: * The 1M token context window is now available on Vertex AI. For more information, see Claude on Vertex AI.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 19, 2025
blocks.text: * Request IDs are now included directly in error response bodies alongside the existing `request-id` header. Learn more in Error shapes.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 18, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve released the Usage & Cost API, allowing administrators to programmatically monitor their organization’s usage and cost data.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 18, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added a new endpoint to the Admin API for retrieving organization information. For details, see the Organization Info Admin API reference.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 13, 2025
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 3.5 models (`claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620` and `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022`). These models will be retired on October 28, 2025. We recommend migrating to Claude Sonnet 4.5 (`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`) for improved performance and capabilities. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 13, 2025
blocks.text: * The 1-hour cache duration for prompt caching no longer requires a beta header. Learn more in 1-hour cache duration.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 12, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched beta support for a 1M token context window in Claude Sonnet 4 on the Claude API and Amazon Bedrock.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 11, 2025
blocks.text: * Some customers might encounter 429 (`rate_limit_error`) errors following a sharp increase in API usage due to acceleration limits on the API. Previously, 529 (`overloaded_error`) errors would occur in similar scenarios.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 8, 2025
blocks.text: * Search result content blocks are out of beta on the Claude API and Vertex AI. This feature enables natural citations for RAG applications with proper source attribution. The beta header `search-results-2025-06-09` is no longer required. Learn more in Search results.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 5, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Opus 4.1, an incremental update to Claude Opus 4 with enhanced capabilities and performance improvements.\* Learn more in Models overview.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 5, 2025
blocks.text: *\*Opus 4.1 does not allow both `temperature` and `top_p` parameters to be specified. Please use only one.*

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 28, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve released `text_editor_20250728`, an updated text editor tool that fixes some issues from the previous versions and adds an optional `max_characters` parameter that allows you to control the truncation length when viewing large files.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 24, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve increased rate limits for Claude Opus 4 on the Claude API to give you more capacity to build and scale with Claude. For customers with usage tier 1-4 rate limits, these changes apply immediately to your account - no action needed.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 21, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the Claude 2.0, Claude 2.1, and Claude Sonnet 3 models. All requests to these models will now return an error. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 17, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve increased rate limits for Claude Sonnet 4 on the Claude API to give you more capacity to build and scale with Claude. For customers with usage tier 1-4 rate limits, these changes apply immediately to your account - no action needed.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 3, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched search result content blocks in beta, enabling natural citations for RAG applications. Tools can now return search results with proper source attribution, and Claude will automatically cite these sources in its responses - matching the citation quality of web search. This eliminates the need for document workarounds in custom knowledge base applications. Learn more in Search results. To enable this feature, use the beta header `search-results-2025-06-09`.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 30, 2025
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude Opus 3 model. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 23, 2025
blocks.text: * In the Console, users with the Developer role can now access the Cost page. Previously, the Developer role allowed access to the Usage page, but not the Cost page.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 11, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched fine-grained tool streaming in beta, a feature that enables Claude to stream tool use parameters without buffering / JSON validation. To enable fine-grained tool streaming, use the beta header `fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14`.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4, our latest models with extended thinking capabilities. Learn more in Models overview.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * The default behavior of extended thinking in Claude 4 models returns a summary of Claude’s full thinking process, with the full thinking encrypted and returned in the `signature` field of `thinking` block output.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched interleaved thinking in beta, a feature that enables Claude to think in between tool calls. To enable interleaved thinking, use the beta header `interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14`.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the Files API in beta, enabling you to upload files and reference them in the Messages API and code execution tool.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the Code execution tool in beta, a tool that enables Claude to execute Python code in a secure, sandboxed environment.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched the MCP connector in beta, a feature that allows you to connect to remote MCP servers directly from the Messages API.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * To increase answer quality and decrease tool errors, we’ve changed the default value for the `top_p` nucleus sampling parameter in the Messages API from 0.999 to 0.99 for all models. To revert this change, set `top_p` to 0.999.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: Additionally, when extended thinking is enabled, you can now set `top_p` to values between 0.95 and 1.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * Our Go SDK has moved from beta to its first stable release.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 22, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added minute and hour level granularity to the Usage page of Console alongside 429 error rates on the Usage page.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 21, 2025
blocks.text: * Our Ruby SDK has moved from beta to its first stable release.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 7, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched a web search tool in the API, allowing Claude to access up-to-date information from the web. Learn more in Web search tool.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 1, 2025
blocks.text: * Cache control must now be specified directly in the parent `content` block of `tool_result` and `document.source`. For backwards compatibility, if cache control is detected on the last block in `tool_result.content` or `document.source.content`, it will be automatically applied to the parent block instead. Cache control on any other blocks within `tool_result.content` and `document.source.content` will result in a validation error.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > April 9th, 2025
blocks.text: * We launched a beta version of the Ruby SDK.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 31st, 2025
blocks.text: * Our Java SDK has moved from beta to its first stable release.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > March 31st, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve moved our Go SDK from alpha to beta.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 27th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added URL source blocks for images and PDFs in the Messages API. You can now reference images and PDFs directly through a URL instead of having to base64-encode them. Learn more in Vision and PDF support.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 27th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added support for a `none` option to the `tool_choice` parameter in the Messages API that prevents Claude from calling any tools. Additionally, you’re no longer required to provide any `tools` when including `tool_use` and `tool_result` blocks.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 27th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, allowing you to test Claude models by changing just your API key, base URL, and model name in existing OpenAI integrations. This compatibility layer supports core chat completions functionality. Learn more in OpenAI SDK compatibility.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched Claude Sonnet 3.7, our most intelligent model yet. Claude Sonnet 3.7 can produce near-instant responses or show its extended thinking step-by-step. One model, two ways to think. Learn more about all Claude models in Models overview.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added vision support to Claude Haiku 3.5, enabling the model to analyze and understand images.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve released a token-efficient tool use implementation, improving overall performance when using tools with Claude. Learn more in Tool use with Claude.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve changed the default temperature in the Console for new prompts from 0 to 1 for consistency with the default temperature in the API. Existing saved prompts are unchanged.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve released updated versions of our tools that decouple the text edit and bash tools from the computer use system prompt:

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: + `bash_20250124`: Same functionality as previous version but is independent from computer use. Does not require a beta header.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: + `text_editor_20250124`: Same functionality as previous version but is independent from computer use. Does not require a beta header.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: + `computer_20250124`: Updated computer use tool with new command options including `hold_key`, `left_mouse_down`, `left_mouse_up`, `scroll`, `triple_click`, and `wait`. This tool requires the `computer-use-2025-01-24` anthropic-beta header.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 24th, 2025
blocks.text: Learn more in Tool use with Claude.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > February 10th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added the `anthropic-organization-id` response header to all API responses. This header provides the organization ID associated with the API key used in the request.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 31st, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve moved our Java SDK from alpha to beta.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 23rd, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve launched citations capability in the API, allowing Claude to provide source attribution for information. Learn more in Citations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 23rd, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve added support for plain text documents and custom content documents in the Messages API.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 21st, 2025
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude 2, Claude 2.1, and Claude Sonnet 3 models. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 15th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve updated prompt caching to be easier to use. Now, when you set a cache breakpoint, we’ll automatically read from your longest previously cached prefix.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 15th, 2025
blocks.text: * You can now put words in Claude’s mouth when using tools.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > January 10th, 2025
blocks.text: * We’ve optimized support for prompt caching in the Message Batches API to improve cache hit rate.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 19th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added support for a delete endpoint in the Message Batches API.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: The following features are now available in the Claude API without a beta header:

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: * Models API: Query available models, validate model IDs, and resolve model aliases to their canonical model IDs.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: * Message Batches API: Process large batches of messages asynchronously at 50% of the standard API cost.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: * Token counting API: Calculate token counts for Messages before sending them to Claude.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: * Prompt Caching: Reduce costs by up to 90% and latency by up to 80% by caching and reusing prompt content.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: * PDF support: Process PDFs to analyze both text and visual content within documents.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: We also released new official SDKs:

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: * Java SDK (alpha)

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 17th, 2024
blocks.text: * Go SDK (alpha)

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 4th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added the ability to group by API key on the Usage and Cost pages of the Developer Console.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > December 4th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added two new **Last used at** and **Cost** columns and the ability to sort by any column on the API keys page of the Developer Console.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 21st, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve released the Admin API, allowing users to programmatically manage their organization’s resources.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 20th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve updated our rate limits for the Messages API. We’ve replaced the tokens per minute rate limit with new input and output tokens per minute rate limits. Read more in Rate limits.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 20th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added support for tool use in the Console Workbench.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 13th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added PDF support for all Claude Sonnet 3.5 models. Read more in PDF support.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 6th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve retired the Claude 1 and Instant models. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 4th, 2024
blocks.text: * Claude Haiku 3.5 is now available on the Claude API as a text-only model.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 1st, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added PDF support for use with the new Claude Sonnet 3.5. Read more in PDF support.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > November 1st, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve also added token counting, which allows you to determine the total number of tokens in a Message prior to sending it to Claude. Read more in Token counting.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 22nd, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added Anthropic-defined computer use tools to our API for use with the new Claude Sonnet 3.5. Read more in Computer use tool.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 22nd, 2024
blocks.text: * Claude Sonnet 3.5, our most intelligent model yet, just got an upgrade and is now available on the Claude API. Read more in the Claude Sonnet documentation.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 8th, 2024
blocks.text: * The Message Batches API is now available in beta. Process large batches of queries asynchronously in the Claude API for 50% less cost. Read more in Batch processing.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 8th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve loosened restrictions on the ordering of `user`/`assistant` turns in our Messages API. Consecutive `user`/`assistant` messages will be combined into a single message instead of erroring, and we no longer require the first input message to be a `user` message.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 8th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve deprecated the Build and Scale plans in favor of a standard feature suite (formerly referred to as Build), along with additional features that are available through sales. Read more in our API pricing information.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > October 3rd, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added the ability to disable parallel tool use in the API. Set `disable_parallel_tool_use: true` in the `tool_choice` field to ensure that Claude uses at most one tool. Read more in Parallel tool use.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 10th, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added Workspaces to the Developer Console. Workspaces allow you to set custom spend or rate limits, group API keys, track usage by project, and control access with user roles. Read more in our Workspaces blog post.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > September 4th, 2024
blocks.text: * We announced the deprecation of the Claude 1 models. Read more in Model deprecations.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 22nd, 2024
blocks.text: * We’ve added support for usage of the SDK in browsers by returning CORS headers in the API responses. Set `dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true` in the SDK instantiation to enable this feature.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 19th, 2024
blocks.text: * 8,192-token outputs on Claude Sonnet 3.5 are out of beta and no longer require the `max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15` header.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > August 14th, 2024
blocks.text: * Prompt caching is now available as a beta feature in the Claude API. Cache and re-use prompts to reduce latency by up to 80% and costs by up to 90%.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 15th, 2024
blocks.text: * Generate outputs up to 8,192 tokens in length from Claude Sonnet 3.5 with the new `anthropic-beta: max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15` header.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 9th, 2024
blocks.text: * Automatically generate test cases for your prompts using Claude in the Developer Console.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > July 9th, 2024
blocks.text: * Compare the outputs from different prompts side by side in the new output comparison mode in the Developer Console.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 27th, 2024
blocks.text: * View API usage and billing broken down by dollar amount, token count, and API keys in the new Usage and Cost tabs in the Developer Console.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 27th, 2024
blocks.text: * View your current API rate limits in the new Rate Limits tab in the Developer Console.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > June 20th, 2024
blocks.text: * Claude Sonnet 3.5, our most intelligent model yet, is now available across the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Vertex AI.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 30th, 2024
blocks.text: * Tool use is out of beta across the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Vertex AI, with no beta header required.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 10th, 2024
blocks.text: * Our prompt generator tool is now available in the Developer Console. Prompt Generator makes it easy to guide Claude to generate high-quality prompts tailored to your specific tasks. Read more in our blog post.

blocks.heading_path: November 3, 2026 > November 2, 2026 > May 10th, 2024
